newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end weaker, focus on Telecel.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end weaker, focus on Telecel.

text.p: 1620 GMT - Portuguese shares ended weaker with futures on Portugal Telecom lower. Turnover 18.6 billion escudos in the cash market. Dealers said the sharp drop in the Spanish bourse, a slight weakening of the dollar and the slight lift on Wall Street made it difficult for Lisbon bourse to find a clear trend. Some investors took advantage of the uncertainty to take profits. Some stocks including Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor took advantage of rosy prospects for first-half results to rise strongly, dealers said.

* Shares in mobile phone operator Telecel dropped eight percent to 13,600 escudos. One operator said: "Someone wanted to break the price of Telecel." The fall of the share indices was heavily influenced by the drop of Telecel, dealers said.
* "I think tomorrow will be like today, with some stocks falling on profit taking and others rising on prospects for results," a dealer said.
* Cement group Cimpor and building companies Somague and Mota & Companhia hit highs amid optimism over prospects for the construction sector, dealers said.
